text:
Amy Chen: Quick heads-up — Riverbend (10 seats) accepted into our early access cohort. They asked for a product walkthrough + a short integration checklist this week. I can take the kickoff call but need eng + SE help for SDK bits.

Mateo Rios: I can own the SDK checklist and sample snippet. Tue 10am PT works for me.

Priya Shah: I'll prepare the enablement deck (15 min) and the two prioritized prompts we want them to test.

Tess Nguyen: I'll coordinate invites and add the customer contacts. Also want to capture their risk signals — they mentioned renewals last quarter were tight. Recommend a short 3-question survey after enablement.

Sam Ortega: Happy to join for integration Q&A. Can we get a recording? I'll do the walkthrough fragment for `client.generate()`.
notes:
Jordan Li: +1 on the 3-question survey. Suggest questions: integration blockers, latency satisfaction, intention to expand seats.

CS-ops-bot: Riverbend added to cohort 'early-access-2026' — seats: 10, owner: Tess Nguyen.

Amy Chen: Perfect. Tess, please add a link to the feedback doc and the post-call survey in the calendar invite. Mateo/Sam — can you paste the SDK snippet and a tiny repro in that doc so CS can ship it to them?

Mateo Rios: Snippet in the shared doc now: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=...)
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-mini', prompt='hello')
print(resp.text)
```

Priya Shah: Added the enablement deck and the two test prompts. I'll also flag 2 prior tickets (latency + auth) as potential follow-ups.

Tess Nguyen: Calendar invite sent for Tue 10am PT with Riverbend and SEs. Survey link included: https://tiny.redwood/survey-riverbend. Will track responses in the doc.

Amy Chen: For renewal risk — we'll set a 2-week usage check: if active tokens < 500 by week 2, outreach + enablement bump. Marking this as a renewal-risk flag in Gainsight.

Sam Ortega: I can run a short 30-min office hours 3 days after enablement for troubleshooting.

Priya Shah: Also recommending we enable prefix caching for their test loads — could cut token cost and show immediate win. I'll add the config suggestion in the doc.

Amy Chen: Thanks all. Action items: Tess — invites & survey; Mateo/Sam — SDK snippets + repro; Priya — deck + config notes; Amy — renewal watch + Gainsight tag. We'll reconvene after the call for initial feedback capture. :white_check_mark:
